hotels.title: Award-Winning Sri Lanka Boutique Oceanfront Suites with All-Inclusive Dining & Nightly Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: On Sri Lanka's palm-kissed southern coast, the best things come in small packages. Enter Uga Prava, a boutique garden-to-coast resort set on Tangalle's golden shores, featuring just seven suites (each with ocean views) and a near-Olympic-size infinity pool that gazes over the endlessly shimmering Indian Ocean. Spend your days surfing - hidden gem Unakuruwa break is only a ten-minute drive south - exploring rocky coves or turtle watching, and return to an all-inclusive dining program built on local seafood and southern Sri Lankan produce. With so few suites scattered across the resorts sprawling gardens, it's an escape that feels wonderfully removed from the crowds.
